newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Consortium to buy Hungary's Aloxid alumina plant.
newsitem.headline: Consortium to buy Hungary's Aloxid alumina plant.

text.p: The Hungarian privatisation agency APV Rt said on Thursday it had decided to sell Aloxid Kft to the consortium currently leasing the alumina plant.

The buyer, Hungarian-British-Austrian consortium of Hungalumina Kft - the only bidder at the tender - will pay a price below the face value, Adam Dudits told APV's weekly news conference, declining to release more financial details.
APV offered a 100 percent stake, worth a nominal 2.071 billion forints, in the alumina plant.

Hungalumina, which includes Austria's Alfer Holding GmbH, Britain's Alucan Metals Corp and Hungary's Metalservice Kft, has rented Aloxid for three years since late last year from state-owned Hungalu group and had an option to buy it.
The consortium signed a three-year lease for the alumina plant with Hungalu Rt late last year. Hungalu is controlled by APV Rt.
The buyer undertook to make investments worth millions of forints in the coming five years and gave guarantees to operate the plant for eight years, Dudits said.
